question: A closed container holds a mixture of two radioactive isotopes $A$ and $B$, possessing half-lives of $3 \text{ days}$ and $9 \text{ days}$ respectively. Initially, the measured activity of $A$ is exactly $4$ times the activity of $B$. After how many days will the activity of isotope $B$ become twice the activity of isotope $A$?
